points.description: Whole solution: every step is valid (identical dice so P(2)=p1²=0.04 gives p1=0.2 and P(12)=p6²=0.01 gives p6=0.1; P(7)=2(p1p6+p2p5+p3p4) with p2+p3+p4+p5=0.7; maximising p2p5+p3p4 by AM-GM/convexity, giving max 0.35²=0.1225 when p3=p4=0 and p2=p5=0.35; p=0.285) AND the final answer is 28. Any invalid step or a wrong final answer earns 0.

rubric.notes: Full mark only if the reasoning is valid throughout and the final answer is 28. Any wrong step or wrong final answer (e.g. 24 or 27 from assuming equal splits) earns 0. No part marks.
rubric.answer_key: Identical dice with face probabilities p1..p6. p1²=0.04 → p1=0.2; p6²=0.01 → p6=0.1. P(7)=2(p1p6+p2p5+p3p4)=2(0.02+p2p5+p3p4). Let a=p2+p5, b=p3+p4, a+b=0.7. p2p5≤a²/4, p3p4≤b²/4, so the sum ≤(a²+b²)/4, which is maximal at a=0.7, b=0: 0.1225 (p2=p5=0.35, p3=p4=0). Then p=2(0.02+0.1225)=0.285, so floor(100p)=28.
